name: dealping-flashsale
description: Root package to run both frontend and backend

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix Dealping_Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Dealping_Frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix Dealping_Backend && npm install --prefix Dealping_Frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix Dealping_Frontend && npm run build --prefix Dealping_Frontend && cp -r Dealping_Frontend/dist ./
